name: Unzen (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Unzen city emblem in light blue, green and orange: light blue and green stylised waves and a mountain with an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Unzen, a city in Nagasaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 October 2005.

features.role: Unzen city emblem — light blue and green stylised waves and a mountain with an orange disc
